lean.quote: Supporting evidence still leans mostly bullish and if buyers can defend 744 (the gap close level) they will prevent threats to the higher low opportunity.
lean.note: 'this week will be all about which direction the trend takes from this position.'

calls.quote: Ideally buyers keep price over 744 which would represent the gap fill reversal level and leave the Wednesday low as an overshoot (excess) secure.
Holding 744 is ideal for these outcomes.
Should price lose the 744, pressure is put on the Wednesday low, 738.15, and we may find price in a daily downtrend sooner rather than lower if that breaks.
Losses of 738.15 change the hourly trend to down and even threaten the daily trend flipping to down as well coming from a lower high rather than the highest high.
